body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2009') -- <Visual News> Energizer presented its rechargeable solar charger at CES 2009, which utilizes the latest solar technology.

It is an ideal hybrid power solution that offers consumers a solar charging solution. The ability to charge in direct sunlight makes it the ultimate charger for outdoor enthusiasts. Pair with long-lasting energizer rechargeable batteries for the perfect solution for all power needs.
